note: ⛔ SNG-482. Body's three authored gaps: an obscure, a bargain, and a soothe.

abilities.name: False Stance
abilities.narrationHints: The weight is on the wrong foot, the shoulder is loaded for a cut that never comes, and the counter they prepared is for a fight happening somewhere else.
abilities.description: Show a body that is about to do something else — a stance that reads as three attacks and resolves as a fourth.
abilities.notFor: Anything that does not read a body — mechanisms, wards, a foe who cannot see you; hiding, which this is not.

bounds.text: ⛔ THEY MUST BE READING YOU. A foe who is not looking cannot be misled
one declared false read per exchange
⚠️ a foe who has fought you before discounts it

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10.

tree.name: False Stance
tree.grants: ⛔ DECLARE THIS IN THE SENSE SLOT TO DENY THEIR READ. Your body says one thing and does another; whatever they learned about you this exchange is wrong.
tree.cannot: They must be reading you. One per exchange.

tree.name: Wrong Fight
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS A PENALTY THEY CARRY. They do not merely fail to read you — they act on the read you gave them, and it is wrong for the fight that happens.
tree.cannot: They must commit to the false read before it costs them.

tree.name: Nothing True
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS TARGETS. Every foe watching you takes the false read, and you may give different ones different fights.
tree.cannot: Everyone in sight of you. A foe who stops watching is unaffected.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-482. Body had NO OBSCURE — the sense slot belonged to Dark and Mind. Erik's own example: 'a stance that reads as three attacks and resolves as a fourth.'

abilities.name: Worth the Work
abilities.narrationHints: They name a figure. The mason looks at the job for a while, names the days and the stone and the two people it will actually take, and nobody argues.
abilities.description: Price labour, materials and time by knowing exactly what they cost — and trade work for what you need where coin will not reach.
abilities.notFor: Anything nobody needs done; work you cannot actually perform; conjuring value that is not there.

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU MUST BE ABLE TO DO THE WORK. A price you cannot deliver is a lie
they must need something done or made
⚠️ prices labour and material — it does not price a favour, a secret or a name

abilities.plainly: A social/investigate action. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10.

tree.name: Days and Stone
tree.grants: ⛔ NAME WHAT A JOB ACTUALLY COSTS in labour, material and time, and be believed. Nobody overcharges you and nobody underpays you.
tree.cannot: You must have seen the job or the thing.

tree.name: Paid in Work
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS WORK AS CURRENCY. Settle a debt, buy passage, or secure lodging by doing the thing they need done — accepted at full value where you have no coin they want.
tree.cannot: The work must be worth what you are taking, and they must need it now.

tree.name: Standing Account
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS CREDIT. Your word on a price is taken in advance across a whole region — materials, tools, passage and hands are extended before you have paid.
tree.cannot: One region. Defaulting ends it there permanently.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-482. Erik: every tradition bargains because there is an economy. BODY'S LEVER IS WHAT ITS LABOUR IS WORTH — and r2 makes work itself a currency, which is the mason's answer to Known Price r2.
abilities._powerSystemFix:
⛔ SNG-487. Erik: 'make sure each skill's power sources are identified and MAKE SENSE.' ⚠️ BODY CARRIED FIVE DIFFERENT VALUES AND THREE WERE NOT POWER SOURCES AT ALL — `reach_body_mind` and `reach_concrete_abstract` are REACH IDS, and `attribute` is a FIELD NAME. Corrected against canon (SNG-445).
⚠️ PURE BODY, NO SOURCE REACHED FOR. Throwing a rock, catching an arrow, saying a true thing, pricing a job — these are skill and years, and canon defines `body` as the flat floor that 'reaches for nothing, so nothing can be taken from it'.

abilities.name: Steady Hands
abilities.narrationHints: No words. A hand on the shoulder, a grip on the wrist, weight taken. The shaking stops because someone else's body is telling theirs that it can.
abilities.description: Put hands on someone coming apart — panicking, shaking, bleeding out, about to swing — and steady them enough to act.
abilities.notFor: Anyone out of reach; grief or despair, which need more than contact; making them agree with you.

bounds.text: ⛔ CONTACT RANGE. This is done with hands
ends fear, panic and rage — not grief, not despair

abilities.plainly: A social/survive action. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10.

tree.name: Hand On Them
tree.grants: ⛔ END FEAR, PANIC OR RAGE IN ONE PERSON YOU CAN TOUCH. The shaking stops, the breath comes back, and they can act this round.
tree.cannot: Contact range, one person, and they must permit it.

tree.name: Held Together
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS DURATION AND WORK. They stay steady while you keep a hand on them — enough to be carried, stitched, talked to, or walked out.
tree.cannot: You are occupied while you hold them.

tree.name: Everyone Standing
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS TARGETS. Steady everyone within arm's reach at once — a stretcher line, a shield wall about to break, a crew in a storm.
tree.cannot: Arm's reach. One use per contest.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-482. Body had no `soothe`. ⚠️ DISTINCT FROM MIND'S QUIET THE ROOM: that works at range on a room, this works by CONTACT on people you can reach, and it does not touch grief.
